title: Moonseed Conservatory
provenance: Original Postern rehearsal authored 27 September 2026. Fictional mechanisms; not Wrenmere canon. Difficulty is not human-calibrated.

intro.storyOn: Under the conservatory roof, moonseed trays wait for the night lamps. A loose prism and three patterned shutters stand between you and the caretaker’s seed drawer. Light here follows the maker’s deliberately unusual demonstration rule.
intro.storyOff: Light exactly beds 1, 3 and 5, then release the seed drawer. Each open shutter toggles its numbered beds; overlapping illumination cancels rather than adding.

ending.storyOn: Beds 1, 3 and 5 glow, and the seed drawer slides forward. You combined the shutter patterns rather than choosing a single pattern that looked close.
ending.storyOff: Beds 1, 3 and 5 glow, and the seed drawer slides forward. You combined the shutter patterns rather than choosing a single pattern that looked close.

solution.storyOn: Take the prism, fit it to the lamp and switch on. Open A, B and C. Their masks combine by toggling: A={1, 2, 4}, B={2, 3}, C={4, 5}; beds 2 and 4 cancel, leaving {1, 3, 5}. Release the drawer. The prism can be removed and all shutters can close again without losing a route to completion.
solution.storyOff: Take the prism, fit it to the lamp and switch on. Open A, B and C. Their masks combine by toggling: A={1, 2, 4}, B={2, 3}, C={4, 5}; beds 2 and 4 cancel, leaving {1, 3, 5}. Release the drawer. The prism can be removed and all shutters can close again without losing a route to completion.

text.storyOn: One removable prism belongs in the lamp. Removing it switches the lamp off.
text.storyOff: One removable prism belongs in the lamp. Removing it switches the lamp off.

text.storyOn: The prism rests in the cradle.
text.storyOff: The prism rests in the cradle.

text.storyOn: The prism is fitted to the lamp.
text.storyOff: The prism is fitted to the lamp.

text.storyOn: With the prism fitted, the lamp can illuminate the shutter system.
text.storyOff: With the prism fitted, the lamp can illuminate the shutter system.

text.storyOn: An open shutter toggles each bed in its mask. A second toggle cancels the first. A affects beds 1, 2, 4; B affects 2, 3; C affects 4, 5. Closed shutters have no effect.
text.storyOff: An open shutter toggles each bed in its mask. A second toggle cancels the first. A affects beds 1, 2, 4; B affects 2, 3; C affects 4, 5. Closed shutters have no effect.

text.storyOn: The numbered display provides the complete lamp pattern, also shown in words below.
text.storyOff: The numbered display provides the complete lamp pattern, also shown in words below.

text.storyOn: The release needs the lamp on and exactly beds 1, 3 and 5 glowing. The other beds must be dark.
text.storyOff: The release needs the lamp on and exactly beds 1, 3 and 5 glowing. The other beds must be dark.
